@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You should not run or do exercise on a full s______h because this can make you feel sick or throw up.
= stomach
~詞義 stomach（n.）胃
~原文 You should not run or do exercise on a full stomach because this can make you feel sick or throw up.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jimmy was injured in a car accident and had to get s______hes on his head.
= stitches
~詞義 stitch（n.）縫針
~原文 Jimmy was injured in a car accident and had to get stitches on his head.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: On weekends, I like to sleep late and then go out for a delicious b______h with my friends.
= brunch
~詞義 brunch（n.）早午餐
~原文 On weekends, I like to sleep late and then go out for a delicious brunch with my friends.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Ms. Chen is a very s______e teacher. She always listens to our explanations and never judges us.
= sensible
~詞義 sensible（adj.）明智的
~原文 Ms. Chen is a very sensible teacher. She always listens to our explanations and never judges us.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Ben bought a new video game c______r because the old one kept disconnecting.
= controller
~詞義 controller（n.）遊戲遙控器(game controller)
~原文 Ben bought a new video game controller because the old one kept disconnecting.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The ______ ran away and hid out in an empty apartment, but later he was found and arrested by the police.
A: avenue
B: bundle
C: criminal
D: vacancy
= C
~詞義 criminal（n.）罪犯
~原文 The criminal ran away and hid out in an empty apartment, but later he was found and arrested by the police.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Ruby enjoys eating at ______ restaurants because she likes to try lots of different types of food.
A: cooker
B: buffet
C: scarf
D: troop
= B
~詞義 buffet（n.）自助餐
~原文 Ruby enjoys eating at buffet restaurants because she likes to try lots of different types of food.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Sue felt that her efforts went down the ______ when her group ignored every suggestion she had made for the project.
A: drain
B: bulb
C: closet
D: hen
= A
~詞義 drain（n.）白費(go down the drain)
~原文 Sue felt that her efforts went down the drain when her group ignored every suggestion she had made for the project.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: I've been working on my computer for five hours, so my neck and shoulders are very ______.
A: tricky
B: stiff
C: vacant
D: criminal
= B
~詞義 stiff（adj.）僵硬的
~原文 I've been working on my computer for five hours, so my neck and shoulders are very stiff.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The farmer was ______ on the arm by a bee while watering the vegetable garden.
A: whipped
B: delayed
C: roasted
D: stung
= D
~詞義 sting（v.）螫;刺
~原文 The farmer was stung on the arm by a bee while watering the vegetable garden.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: avenue
B: criminals
C: concert
D: bulb
E: scarf
F: vacancies

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Scientists from different countries worked in ______ to track the disease and share information that might speed up finding a cure.
= C
~詞義 concert（n.）共同(in concert)
~原文 Scientists from different countries worked in concert to track the disease and share information that might speed up finding a cure.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: We need to change the light ______ in our bathroom. It keeps blinking.
= D
~詞義 bulb（n.）燈泡
~原文 We need to change the light bulb in our bathroom. It keeps blinking.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Vicky called the hotel to book a room for tonight, but there were no ______.
= F
~詞義 vacancy（n.）空房;空位
~原文 Vicky called the hotel to book a room for tonight, but there were no vacancies.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: My grandmother is knitting a beautiful ______ for me as a Christmas present.
= E
~詞義 scarf（n.）圍巾
~原文 My grandmother is knitting a beautiful scarf for me as a Christmas present.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: There are tall trees on both sides of the ______.
= A
~詞義 avenue（n.）大街
~原文 There are tall trees on both sides of the avenue.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: tugged
B: tricky
C: cables
D: stirring
E: closets
F: vacant

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: There were no ______ seats on the bus, so we had to stand for the whole journey.
= F
~詞義 vacant（adj.）空的
~原文 There were no vacant seats on the bus, so we had to stand for the whole journey.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: My sister ______ at my sleeve, so I turned around to see what was wrong.
= A
~詞義 tug（v.）(用力)拉
~原文 My sister tugged at my sleeve, so I turned around to see what was wrong.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: You need to keep ______ the soup while it cooks, or else the bottom may burn.
= D
~詞義 stir（v.）攪拌
~原文 You need to keep stirring the soup while it cooks, or else the bottom may burn.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The students asked many ______ questions, so the teacher had to spend a lot of time answering them.
= B
~詞義 tricky（adj.）棘手的
~原文 The students asked many tricky questions, so the teacher had to spend a lot of time answering them.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Some workers were digging up the road to lay ______, which caused a traffic jam for three hours.
= C
~詞義 cable（n.）電纜
~原文 Some workers were digging up the road to lay cables, which caused a traffic jam for three hours.
